implementation.contract: Sole current outbox_entry.v3 and local_receipt.v3 require canonical serviceOrigin and exact submitUrl, including mounted/relay paths. Both JS and .NET validate the shared serialized fixture. Server payload/digest/idempotency contract is unchanged.

implementation.redirects: Browser Fetch uses redirect:error and credentials:omit. Default SDK HttpClientHandler disables redirects; injected clients must supply the same policy.
